free_parameters.name: n_head
free_parameters.why: Two heads give the mixed cache four rows so both the first and second segments are non-empty.

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: Smallest convenient head width; line 426 does not depend on the head dimension.

free_parameters.name: input_dim
free_parameters.why: n_head * head_dim; only used to size the cache and the CPU attention workspace.

free_parameters.name: gpu_batch_size
free_parameters.why: Makes gpu_batch_size * n_head = 4, allowing a 50/50 mixed split with both shards non-empty.

free_parameters.name: num_gpu_batches
free_parameters.why: load_cache does not read it; one batch keeps the setup minimal.

free_parameters.name: w_gpu_percent
free_parameters.why: No weight allocation happens; the target only reads the KV cache policy fields.

free_parameters.name: w_cpu_percent
free_parameters.why: Keeps the weight percentages valid without placing weights on a GPU.

free_parameters.name: act_gpu_percent
free_parameters.why: Activation placement is irrelevant to load_cache.

free_parameters.name: act_cpu_percent
free_parameters.why: Activation placement is irrelevant to load_cache.

free_parameters.name: cache_gpu_percent
free_parameters.why: With four cache rows this makes the first mixed shard non-empty, which selects path 2.

free_parameters.name: cache_cpu_percent
free_parameters.why: Makes the CPU shard non-empty, matching the mixed-cache path 2 scenario.

free_parameters.name: overlap
free_parameters.why: load_cache does not read it; disabling overlap keeps setup deterministic.

free_parameters.name: sep_layer
free_parameters.why: One CPU attention workspace is enough; sep_layer matches the benchmark's default layout.

free_parameters.name: pin_weight
free_parameters.why: No weights are allocated; keeps the CPU-only setup fast.

free_parameters.name: compress_weight
free_parameters.why: Compression is unrelated to the target assert.

free_parameters.name: compress_cache
free_parameters.why: Must be false so load_cache chooses path 2 instead of the compressed path 0.

free_parameters.name: do_sample
free_parameters.why: Sampling is irrelevant to cache loading.

free_parameters.name: temperature
free_parameters.why: Default generation temperature; unused by load_cache.

free_parameters.name: prompt_len
free_parameters.why: Small prompt so the real CPU copies before line 426 are cheap; the assert does not depend on it.

free_parameters.name: gen_len
free_parameters.why: Only sizes the attention workspace; the assert does not depend on it.

free_parameters.name: i
free_parameters.why: Any i != 0 decodes a cached token; 1 is the first decode step.

free_parameters.name: layer_id
free_parameters.why: load_cache does not read layer_id; 0 avoids prefetch-only branches.

free_parameters.name: enable_prefetching
free_parameters.why: Prefetching is not part of load_cache and is disabled to keep the call direct.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixes torch/numpy/random seeds for deterministic CPU allocation and copies.

execution.entry_reason: Region.call_chain status is not_found: TorchDevice.mha computes attention and never calls SelfAttention.load_cache. The driver therefore calls the deepest chain function directly; it is the repository's real load_cache and every callee before line 426 is the real CPU implementation.
